items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Your daddy happened to hire him first. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He was playing before Oliver. Yeah. Because he played with the Sapira band.

ctx.x: He was playing in the same time, but he was playing with my daddy before Oliver.
